read_only_account_metadata.limits: Metadata proves partial server contact/writes; does not prove decryption, local apply, complete synchronization or the initial device failure. No user payload/key, deletion, repair or consent change was performed.

proven_defects.name: outgoing-batch-not-drained
proven_defects.before: Actual deployed RPC acknowledged 100 of 203 queued rows with has_more=false; 103 remained and the 13 October success time was correctly retained.
proven_defects.fix: Treat acknowledged outgoing batches with pending rows as bounded forward progress independently of inbound pagination. Stop on every failure or zero progress; preserve retry/dead-letter/cursor safeguards.

proven_defects.name: identical-restored-inbox-treated-as-conflict
proven_defects.before: An empty second SQLite database restored 203 rows, then a second sync reported 203 false conflicts on the unchanged durable inbox.
proven_defects.fix: Acknowledge replay only for already synced rows with identical timestamps, revision, tombstone and full supported payload. Changed health/goal/date values or pending local edits remain conflicts.

actual_live.nutrition_and_goals: Actual separately consented V2 repository-authored data, stable UUID relationships, unknown vs zero nutrients and goals survive restore/reopen.
actual_live.crypto: Real AES-256-GCM locally with actual authenticated Vault key; secure storage, path and connectivity OS channels modeled on Windows.

legacy_followup.root_cause: An optional profile birth preference containing an empty string restores as absence; replay formerly compared it against null as a different value. Metadata subsecond dates also differed from the existing SQLite integer-seconds precision.
legacy_followup.repair: Normalize only optional profile preference absence/trim and compare replay dates at the actual storage precision. Revision, owner, dirty-row and health-value safeguards remain.

import_review.notes: The initial Python datetime diagnostic was stricter than Dart and was corrected by executing the actual Dart date decoder; no application data was changed to satisfy that diagnostic.
